create_TorchDistributedCommBackend: create a TorchDistributedCommBackend instance initialized with a torch distributed ProcessGroup
build_Get_rank: build a call to Get_rank to retrieve the current rank from the distributed group
build_Get_size: build a call to Get_size to retrieve the total size of the distributed group
test_allgather: test the allgather method to collect integer data from all ranks in the group
test_bcast: test the bcast method to broadcast data from a root rank to all other ranks
